parole.significato: Marks a yes–no tag question prompting the listener to clarify or confirm something.
parole.testo: From Hokkien 啊 (--a, a) and Teochew 啊 (a⁷), reinforced by Tamil -ஆ (-ā, etymology 3, particle sense 1) among Tamil speakers (Baskaran, 1988).

parole.significato: A dirty old man; a pervert.
parole.testo: From Hokkien 痴哥伯 (chhi-ko-peh) or Teochew 痴哥伯 (ci¹ go¹ bêh⁴, “dirty old man; lecher; pervert”).
Unadapted borrowing from Malay diam. For some Chinese speakers, this word is reanalysed as a loan from Hokkien 恬 (tiām, “silent”) or Teochew 恬 (diam⁷, “silent”).

parole.significato: Used to suggest that one is doomed, or as good as dead.
parole.testo: die + liao (indicates a change of state), from Hokkien 了 (liáu) or Teochew 了 (liao²), with the tone of Mandarin 了 (liǎo). Partial calque of Hokkien 死了 (sí liáu).
Calque of Hokkien 蚵煎 (ô-chian) or Teochew 蚵烙 (ô-loah).

From Hokkien 貓 /猫 (niau / ngiau, “cat; stingy”), with influence from Singapore Teochew 貓 /猫 (ngiao¹, “cat; stingy”). See also Hokkien 貓潲 /猫潲 (niau-siâu, “stingy”), 貓神 /猫神 (niau-sîn, “stingy”), 貓𡳞 /猫𡳞 (niau-lān / niau-lǎn, “stingy”), 貓筩 /猫筒 (niau-thāng, “stingy”).

parole.significato: With sugar and no condensed milk added.
parole.testo: From Hokkien 烏 /乌 (o͘, “black”) or Teochew 烏 /乌 (ou¹, “black”).

parole.significato: Drunk or inebriated, or appearing so; tipsy.
